state.j08: J08 (screen corners) is in verification: a corner window now exists only while it draws the fake rounding or hosts a hot corner, a hot-corner-only window is its 250x5 region in size and input mask, and the top hot corners work with fakeScreenRounding 0 (the founder's seat, where they were dead). Defaults: cornerOpen.enable true, top corners, clickless false (hovering does nothing), clicklessCornerEnd true (pushing into the outer 2 px of the strip toggles the sidebar), a click anywhere in the strip toggles it, valueScroll true (wheel in the strip changes volume right, brightness left). J08 added armed: a corner fires once per visit.
state.reopen: J08 observed in the nested harness: a sidebar closed over IPC while the pointer rests in its corner is open again one 150 ms sample later and stays open, with and without armed, on both corners; with the pointer elsewhere it stays closed. Likely path: the sidebar's surface covered the strip, the strip got a leave (re-arming), and when the sidebar unmaps the strip gets an enter and a motion at the corner end, which fires. A user who pushes into the corner, then closes the sidebar with Escape or a key without moving the mouse, gets it back. Cause not traced; dev (rounding on) unchecked.
state.cost: On the seat's config (rounding off, top corners on) the two now-live corner windows cost about 12 MB of shell memory (PSS, headless, runs vary by up to 7.7 MB). One full-width 5 px strip per screen with a two-rectangle input mask would be one window instead of two per screen; the job file said a hot-corner-only window is the size of its region.
state.first_ask: J08_window_count one_strip_window p=0.64, J08_reopen require_movement_after_enter p=0.96 (jev-1.13.0). The window-count framing left out the default config.
state.window_counts: Windows per screen. J08 as built (each corner window does both jobs): default config (rounding on, top hot corners) 4, the seat's config (rounding off) 2, both off 0. A hot-corner strip next to separate rounding windows: default 5, seat 1. Top and bottom edge strips that also draw the roundings: default 2, seat 1, the biggest rewrite of the inherited file, and the top strip is a rounding-tall transparent overlay across the whole width. Each extra window measured at about 6 MB (PSS, headless), within run-to-run noise of 7.7 MB.

J08_window_count.instructions: How should the corner windows be arranged, given the window counts per config?

criteria.keep_corner_windows: As built: 4 per screen on the default config, 2 on the seat's, 0 with both off. Strongest case: the fewest windows on the default config, each window its own region, the smallest change to the inherited file. Cost: on the seat's config one window more than a strip.
criteria.hot_corner_strip: One hot-corner strip next to separate rounding windows: 5 on the default config, 1 on the seat's. Strongest case: the seat saves one window. Cost: the default config, what most users run, gains a window.
criteria.edge_strips: Top and bottom edge strips that draw the roundings and host the hot corners: 2 on the default config, 1 on the seat's. Strongest case: the fewest windows everywhere. Cost: the biggest rewrite of the inherited file, a whole-width transparent overlay at each edge, and savings inside the measurement noise.
